title: UnDercontrol SavedQuery Resource
description: Schema for SavedQuery YAML resource files. A saved query is a named task filter; the same objects power the web app's Saved Queries view (/tasks/saved-queries).

name.description: Display name for the saved query.

query_string.description: The task query string this filter runs (e.g. "status:in-progress tag:urgent").

example.description:
Example saved query YAML:

apiVersion: ud/v1
kind: SavedQuery
spec:
  name: Urgent work
  query_string: "status:in-progress tag:urgent"

Round-trip: `ud describe saved-query <id> -o apply` emits exactly id + name + query_string, so piping it back into `ud apply` is a no-op.
